paths.description: Event delivery from external provider (e.g. Stripe, GitHub) to the Zen Mesh ingester endpoint
paths.persistence_point: in-memory event buffer before delivery processing
paths.acknowledgement_point: ingester returns 2xx to provider upon receipt
paths.retry_limit_or_unresolved: provider-managed; not controlled by Zen Mesh
paths.terminal_failure_behavior: provider retries or drops based on its own policy
paths.customer_responsibility: Configure provider to send to correct Zen Mesh endpoint URL
paths.limitations: Zen Mesh cannot influence provider retry behavior. Provider signature verification supported for Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, Twilio.

paths.description: Zen Mesh ingester accepts incoming webhook event from provider
paths.persistence_point: in-memory event store; persistent store planned
paths.terminal_failure_behavior: DLQ after retry exhaustion; operator can inspect, replay, archive, or discard
paths.evidence_generated: delivery receipt with event_id, source, destination, mode, timestamp, outcome
paths.customer_responsibility: Configure endpoint provider pack and signature verification
paths.limitations: Deduplication state is in-memory; persistent store planned. Signature verification supported for select providers only.

paths.description: Ingester normalizes incoming webhook into internal event format for routing
paths.customer_responsibility: Provide valid webhook payload matching expected format
paths.limitations: Normalization failures treated as ingestion errors

paths.description: Event passes through delivery pipeline including filtering, fan-out, and routing
paths.acknowledgement_point: event exits pipeline to delivery queue
paths.terminal_failure_behavior: pipeline failure treated as delivery failure; enters retry/DLQ path
paths.customer_responsibility: Configure filters, transforms, and fan-out routing correctly
paths.limitations: JSONPath-based filtering and transforms; no ordering guarantees

paths.description: Event delivery from data plane runtime to destination target (HTTP endpoint)
paths.terminal_failure_behavior: exhausted → DLQ; operator inspects, replays, archives, or discards
paths.evidence_generated: delivery attempt record including HTTP status, response body, timestamp, duration, error details
paths.customer_responsibility: Ensure target endpoint is reachable and returns correct responses
paths.limitations: At-least-once only; duplicates possible during recovery scenarios. Delivery guarantees are scenario-specific (local/mock/cloud-demo), not production-level.

paths.description: Delivery from edge plane (zen-egress) to private target within customer network
paths.persistence_point: delivery attempt history in data plane
paths.evidence_generated: delivery attempt record with outcome, timestamps, integrity proofs
paths.customer_responsibility: Ensure private network allows outbound egress connectivity; deploy and maintain edge plane (Kubernetes or Edge Lite)
paths.limitations: Edge Lite runtime not yet published. Kubernetes Edge Plane at WIRED_SANDBOX. mTLS delivery supported (outbound-only). Customer-managed egress → target mTLS is configurable, not Zen-mandatory.

paths.description: End-to-end private delivery from provider event through edge plane to private target
paths.acceptance_point: event received by edge plane ingester (optional) or data plane
paths.persistence_point: in-memory event store with delivery history
paths.terminal_failure_behavior: exhausted → DLQ; operator replays after issue resolution
paths.evidence_generated: delivery receipt, delivery attempt records, evidence manifests
paths.customer_responsibility: Deploy and maintain edge plane infrastructure; monitor edge plane health
paths.limitations: Private-edge path convergence proven in local mock only. Not private data plane general availability; not customer-owned guarantee. Edge Plane never requires inbound ports.

paths.description: Automatic or manual retry of a failed delivery attempt
paths.acceptance_point: retry initiated by system (automatic) or operator (manual via API/CLI)
paths.retry_limit_or_unresolved: 5 attempts total (automatic); manual retry has no documented limit
paths.terminal_failure_behavior: exhausted → DLQ after 5 automatic retry attempts
paths.evidence_generated: retry receipt with delivery_id, status, message
paths.customer_responsibility: For manual retry: verify failure is resolved before retrying
paths.limitations: Retry re-uses original delivery — does not re-ingest from source. Retry is idempotent — calling retry on already-retried delivery does not create duplicates. Permanent failures (4xx except 429) should not be retried.

paths.description: Operator-initiated replay of events from DLQ or delivery history
paths.persistence_point: events re-queued from retained payload store or DLQ
paths.retry_limit_or_unresolved: N/A (operator-controlled; after replay, standard retry policy applies)
paths.retention: Free: 7 days basic DLQ/replay; Pro: 30 days advanced; Business: 30+ days; Enterprise: custom
paths.terminal_failure_behavior: replayed event follows standard delivery/retry/DLQ path
paths.evidence_generated: replay receipt, replayed event IDs, audit reference correlating with original delivery
paths.customer_responsibility: Verify issue is resolved before initiating replay; select appropriate event range
paths.limitations: Requires retained payload/context — not all deliveries replayable. Batch and dry-run replay are PLANNED_V1_1. Replay respects retention and plan limits. Replaying same event range may produce duplicates.

paths.description: Retiring (deleting) a resource that may have in-flight or pending deliveries
paths.acceptance_point: delete/retire request submitted via UI, API, or CLI
paths.terminal_failure_behavior: resource deleted; in-flight deliveries may be lost. No draining of in-flight deliveries on disable. Formal retirement with evidence is PLANNED_V1_1.
paths.customer_responsibility: Ensure no critical in-flight deliveries before deleting. If retire is needed with evidence, use delete or wait for PLANNED_V1_1 retire operation.
paths.limitations: Disabling does not drain in-flight deliveries. Deletion is permanent — recovery requires recreating the resource. Resource retirement with evidence is not yet available (PLANNED_V1_1).

generation_method: hand-maintained JSON aligned with delivery API contract and evidence documentation
implementation_status_semantics: IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED: delivery path confirmed working. WIRED_SANDBOX: verified in sandbox, not production-live.
verification_status_semantics: WIRED_SANDBOX: verified through sandbox test suite.
